title: 第1章 金丹雏形第2章 偷天换日
slug: 我金丹呢你当结石摘出来了
lines: 江城。
苏业睁开眼睛，入目依旧是一片陌生的天花板，发黄的乳胶漆，角落一小块水渍，老式日光灯管微微闪烁。
他终于接受了穿越的这个事实。
“既然回不去了，就珍惜这边的生活吧。”
长长的一声叹息让这间捡漏的出租屋内更加安静了些，脑海中那庞杂的记忆在几天前涌来，像是被人硬塞进来的，却又严丝合缝。
苏业，二十四岁，规培第一年，江城市第一人民医院，泌尿外科轮转中。
所有的记忆平静地浮上来。
他看了一眼手机。
八点报到。
时间紧迫啊。
苏业盯着屏幕看了两秒。
上辈子迟到扣工资，这辈子迟到扣学分，命运的齿轮是一点面子都不给。
弹射起床，刷牙洗脸九十秒，白大褂塞进书包，出门。
下楼路过早餐摊的时候，苏业想了想，还是买了两个包子一杯豆浆，今天大概率要跟台手术，万一低血糖晕在手术台上，那就完蛋了。
他咬着包子上了公交，靠在最后一排，一边吃一边消化脑子里那些不属于自己的记忆。
窗外的城市陌生又普通，江城，二线城市，不大不小，第一人民医院是本市最大的三甲，规培生在这儿轮转，什么病种都能见着，什么苦也都得吃。
苏业倒不觉得苦，上辈子996都熬过来了，这点强度不算什么。
反而这一世的这个家伙，貌似‘牛’的很，医学硕士……啧啧。
8:11，他踩着一个不算太离谱的时间到了泌尿外科门诊。
在诊室门口整理了一下白大褂，刚准备推门，就听到里面传来一个年轻人中气十足的声音。
“可是这两天我感觉我的脑袋格外的清晰，除了腰疼点外，我感觉我的状态可好了，医生啊，你说有没有一种可能，我这不是结石，是金丹呢，就是，就是小说里那种很厉害的，能一步千里，能弹指崩山的那种金丹大能？“
诊室内沉默了一小会儿。
苏业站在门口，哭笑不得。
现在这些乐子人是真多。
他穿越来后上班没几天，就遇到了不少这样的：有觉得自己被外星人植入芯片的，有怀疑自己血管里流的不是血是汽油的，还有个大爷信誓旦旦说自己放的屁能点着！当时苏业都被唬住了，后来查出来是肠道产气菌感染，确实能点着，但跟超能力没有半毛钱关系。
不过医院本就是痛苦之地，苦中作乐也不失为一种好品德。
苏业推门进去。
“张老师，不好意思，迟到了。“
主治医师张远平五十出头，花白头发，面相严肃，他看了苏业一眼，没说什么，只是点了点头。
诊桌对面坐着一个二十岁出头的大学生，动漫t恤，眼神里写满了清澈的愚蠢，他旁边的中年女人，应该是他妈，表情写满了“我怎么生了这么个东西。”
张远平把b超报告递过来：“你看看。”
苏业接过来扫了一眼。
左肾盂内强回声团，1.8x1.4cm，后方伴声影，左侧输尿管上段轻度扩张，左肾轻度积水。
再看ct报告，目光在一个数字上停了一瞬。
苏业记忆如水一般涌出，轻车熟路的说道：“张老师，ct值1847，密度偏高，体外碎石效果不理想。结石将近两公分，有轻度积水——考虑经皮肾镜。”
张远平赞许点头：“可能是胱氨酸结石，取出来送检看看。“
他转向那位患者叮嘱道：“住院手术，全麻，术前要做血常规、凝血、肝肾功……护士会交代，术前八小时禁食禁水。”
大学生被他妈拽着往外走，到门口还回头看了苏业一眼：
“哥，真不是金丹？”
“不是。”
“好吧。”
一巴掌被他妈拍在后脑勺上，拖走了。
content_en:
Jiangcheng.
Su ye opened his eyes and saw an unfamiliar ceiling, yellow latex paint, a small water stain in the corner, and old-fashioned fluorescent tubes flickering slightly.
He finally accepted the fact of time travel.
"Since you can't go back, just cherish your life here."
A long sigh made the leak-picked rental house even quieter. The complex memories in my mind from a few days ago seemed to have been forced in, but they fit perfectly.
Su Ye, 24 years old, in the first year of regular training, is currently rotating at the Department of Urology at Jiangcheng City First People's Hospital.
All the memories came up peacefully.
He glanced at his phone.
7:47.
Report at eight o'clock.
Time is running out.
Su ye stared at the screen for two seconds.
In the previous life, wages were deducted for being late, and credits will be deducted for being late in this life. The gear of fate is to give no face at all.
Get out of bed, brush your teeth and wash your face for ninety seconds, stuff your white coat into your schoolbag, and go out.
When he went downstairs and passed the breakfast stall, Su ye thought about it and bought two steamed buns and a cup of soy milk. There was a high probability that he would have an operation today. If he fainted due to low blood sugar on the operating table, it would be the end.
He bit the bun and got on the bus, leaning on the last row, eating while digesting the memories in his mind that were not his.
The city outside the window is strange and ordinary, Jiangcheng, a second-tier city, neither big nor small. The First People's Hospital is the largest top three hospital in the city. The trainees rotate here, and they can see all kinds of diseases and suffer all kinds of hardships.
Su Ye didn't feel it was hard. He had survived 996 in his previous life, so this intensity was nothing.
On the contrary, this guy in this life seems to be very good. He has a master's degree in medicine... tsk tsk.
At 8:11, he arrived at the urology clinic at a not too outrageous time.
I straightened my white coat at the door of the clinic, and just as I was about to open the door, I heard the angry voice of a young man coming from inside.
"But in the past two days, I feel that my head is particularly clear. Except for the pain in my waist, I feel that my condition is getting better. Doctor, do you think there is a possibility that this is not a stone, but a golden elixir? That is, the kind of powerful golden elixir in the novel, which can move a thousand miles in one step and collapse mountains with a snap of its fingers?"
There was silence in the clinic for a short while.
Su ye stood at the door, dumbfounded.
There are so many people having fun these days.
Within a few days of going to work after traveling back in time, he encountered many people like this: some felt that they had been implanted with chips by aliens, some suspected that the blood flowing in their veins was not blood but gasoline, and there was an old man who swore that his farts could light them on fire! Su ye was frightened at the time, but later it was found out that it was an intestinal gas-producing bacterial infection. It could indeed be lit on fire, but it had nothing to do with superpowers.
However, hospitals are places of suffering, and taking pleasure in suffering is also a good virtue.
Su ye pushed the door open and went in.
"Teacher Zhang, I'm sorry, I'm late."
The attending physician, Zhang Yuanping, was in his early fifties, with gray hair and a serious face. He glanced at Su Ye and didn't say anything, just nodded.
Opposite the examination table sat a college student in his early twenties, wearing an anime T-shirt, with clear stupidity written in his eyes. The middle-aged woman next to him, who must be his mother, had an expression written all over her, "Why did I give birth to such a thing?"
Zhang Yuanping handed over the B-ultrasound report: "Take a look."
Su ye took it and glanced at it.
There was a strong echogenic mass in the left renal pelvis, 1.8x1.4cm, with acoustic shadow behind it, the left upper ureter was slightly dilated, and the left kidney had mild hydrops.
Looking at the CT report again, my eyes stopped on a number for a moment.
Su Ye's memories came out like water, and he said with familiarity: "Mr. Zhang, the CT value is 1847, the density is high, and the effect of extracorporeal lithotripsy is not ideal. The stone is nearly two centimeters, and there is slight water accumulation - consider percutaneous nephroscopy."
Zhang Yuanping nodded in approval: "It may be a cystine stone. Take it out and send it for examination."
He turned to the patient and warned: "Hospital surgery, general anesthesia, blood routine, coagulation, liver and kidney function tests before the operation... The nurse will explain that no food or water is allowed eight hours before the operation."
The college student was dragged out by his mother. When he reached the door, he looked back at Su ye:
"Brother, is it really not a golden elixir?"
"No."
"Okay."
He was slapped on the back of the head by his mother and dragged away.
title_en: Chapter 1 The Prototype of the Golden Elixir Chapter 2 Changing the Heaven and the Sun
